messages:
Ana (obs-eng): quick follow-up from the telemetry enrichment RFC — we still need a concrete plan for propagating billing/context across async boundaries (kafka -> worker -> db)
Mike L: agree. current approach (inject header on http -> kafka message) loses metadata when jobs get re-queued by legacy workers
Ravi: can we rely on trace-id alone and reconstruct billing via route lookup? that seems lossy for multi-tenant RBAC flows
Ana (obs-eng): route lookup works sometimes but it's brittle + expensive. proposal: introduce a thin envelope field `billing_context` that travels with the message as a serialized header. keys: billing_key, org_id, cost_center, sampling_reason, schema_v
Sara P: +1 to envelope. needs schema versioning and guardrails so old consumers don't explode cardinality when they read unknown fields
Kevin (infra): operational concern: if we carry cost_center + feature_flag combos we'll blow up our tag cardinality in metrics + traces. we need bucketing or hashing rules at ingest
Mike L: suggestion: canonicalize billing_context server-side before emit. rules: truncate cost_center to 12 chars, map unknowns -> "unknown_cost", and compute `billing_bucket = sha256(billing_key)[:8]` for metrics tags
Ravi: hashing helps but makes debugging harder. we should also keep a low-volume audit stream that stores full billing_context for 30 days for investigations
Ana (obs-eng): agreed — main path hashed for high-cardinality metrics/traces, audit stream for raw joins. audit stream can be sampled 1% by default and 100% for high-risk customers
Sara P: how do we pass this through existing worker queue adapters? adding a header is easy for kafka but SQS needs message attribute support. plus lambda/FAAS wrappers drop unknown attrs sometimes
Kevin (infra): plan: telemetry-proxy layer will serialize billing_context to `X-Rw-Billing-Env` header (base64 json). adapters will be updated in two phases: kafka + s3 ingestion first, then SQS/lambda. fallback: encode minimal `billing_bucket` in standard header for services that can't accept big attrs
Mike L: runtime: add `schema_v` and a light validator at ingest to reject malformed envelopes. log rejected examples to `ingest-errors` stream (no retries) and metric `ingest.envelope.rejects`
Ana (obs-eng): sampling interplay: we must preserve `sampling_reason` so evals can detect when traces were dropped vs sampled. also need to tag whether KV-cache hit vs full gen for cost attribution
Ravi: about cost attribution aggregation — should we do enrichment pre-ingest (join and emit enriched event) or post-ingest at query time? pre-ingest reduces query complexity but increases ingest CPU and storage
Sara P: prefer pre-ingest for SLA'd dashboards (billing reports). do post-ingest enrichment for ad-hoc queries. we can have a lightweight enrichment step that uses a local cache with TTL 5m and fallback to lookup service
Kevin (infra): ensure enrichment service runs as a sidecar with LRU cache and can be horizontally scaled. add circuit breaker so enrich failures mark events as `enrich_miss` rather than dropping
Mike L: implementation notes: code path in telemetry-proxy will be ~100 LOC. I'll add unit tests and a small integration test that writes to kafka and asserts the `X-Rw-Billing-Env` makes it to consumer
Sara P: I'll draft a short RFC addendum with schema example and cardinality controls. propose owners + timeline: Sara -> RFC addendum by EOW, Mike -> telemetry-proxy patch next sprint, Kevin -> adapter updates phased rollout, Ravi -> audit stream consumer
Ana (obs-eng): ops/obs questions: retention policy for audit stream? default 30d seems fine, but enterprise customers may need longer — put as config per-org
Ravi: we'll also add a nightly job that computes org-level attribution using the audit stream to reconcile hashed metrics -> raw records for billing accuracy
ingest-bot: NOTE: new topic created: "billing_context envelope". Please link RFC addendum when available
deploy-bot: staging deployment of telemetry-proxy patch scheduled for 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC (canary 10%) :rocket:
Ana (obs-eng): action items summarized: Sara: RFC addendum + schema examples (due EOW). Mike: telemetry-proxy changes + tests (next sprint). Kevin: adapter rollout plan + circuit breaker. Ravi: audit stream consumer design. I'll schedule a 30m sync Thursday to walk through patch and rollout steps
Mike L: ack. I'll post the branch and integration test link in the thread when ready :thumbsup:
Sara P: thanks all, good momentum.
